feedback: Reed's confession follows the strongest available chain: the erased original-contents warning, his knowledge of the full file, the admitted sample and his visit to the waiting glass. It confirms the actual transfer rather than introducing a new access privilege, chemical trick or unseen accomplice. The exact purpose of taking the sample becomes explicit, but that was a reasonable deduction before voting. Chip and Elle admitting their lesser wrongs provides emotional resolution and makes their defensive performances more intelligible. Reed's final request that Claire leave his name attached to the act gives the credit theme a satisfying turn. I still regard the pre-vote case as a strong comparative inference rather than a unique proof, but this confession feels earned.
